name: 31 + Pre Evolution Soccer's One-Minute Dance after a Golden Goal in The Master League + Cântico das Criaturas + Redemption
description: This is the second session of the Miguel Gomes cinema cycle, featuring four short films by the director: 31, Pre-Evolution Soccer's One-Minute Dance After a Golden Goal in the Master League, Cântico das Criaturas, and Redemption.
longDescription:
This event is the second session of the Miguel Gomes - Retrospetiva Integral e Carta Branca cinema cycle. It presents a dialogue between the director's filmography and his cinematic influences.

The session includes four short films by Miguel Gomes. These are "31" (2001), "Pre-Evolution Soccer's One-Minute Dance After a Golden Goal in the Master League" (2004), "Cântico das Criaturas" (2006), and "Redemption" (2013).

The event takes place at Serralves on November 8, 2026, starting at 17:00. Ticket prices range from €1.50 to €3.
